android.description: Android-only additions to `default`: leaving the app from Back. The webview takes Back over (`onBackButtonPress`, allowed by `core:default`) only while it has a layer to close; `exit` covers a press that lands as the last layer closes. Never granted to the desktop, which has no Back.

default.description: The Winnow window's capabilities. Every entry here corresponds to a call the frontend actually makes, and the list is deliberately short: Winnow's own `invoke` commands are the product surface, and the window permissions below are the only plugin surface the webview touches. Notably absent are `store`, `os`, `autostart` and the dialog/opener/notification JS APIs — the Rust side calls those plugins directly, and Rust calls are not subject to the ACL. They were previously granted, which made the window's reach considerably wider than its behaviour.

desktop.description: Desktop-only additions to `default`: the tray, which Android does not have.
